# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 71 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_071_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 71

**1** Jesus said: "I will destroy this house, and no one will be able to build it again."

---

**Consensus Notes (SOPHIA):**

**Text:** This is the Thomas version of the temple saying (cf. Mark 14:58; John 2:19). Crucially, Thomas: (1) does not say "temple" — just "house"; (2) has no three-day rebuilding promise; (3) the destruction is final and absolute.

**"Destroy"** — EMET preferred over "tear down" (LOGOS) — broader semantic range fits the ambiguity; "bring down" (PNEUMA) is too colloquial for this charged saying.

**Theological Note:** The absolute finality ("no one will be able to build it again") is the Thomasine distinctive: no resurrection reversal is promised here. This may be: (a) a purer form of the saying before temple-interpretation, (b) a deliberate de-eschatologizing in Thomas, or (c) a reference to the ego/body ("house" as dwelling of the soul).

**Synoptic Parallels:** Mark 14:58; Matt 26:61; John 2:19. All Synoptic and Johannine versions include the rebuilding; Thomas alone makes the destruction permanent.
